about: Rumours, mistakes and lies on the road (#1580, knowledge slice G; docs/knowledge-model-design.md §7). Written by hand: every entry is a placeholder for the owner to review. `propositions` are the things people make claims about, each with a neutral `label` (what the journal files it under; never the answer) and the facts (by id, from facts.ts) that speak to it; `check`, if any, is how the Warden can see for themself: being in that village. `lies` are what a person says instead of what they know: the topic, the words, how sure they make it sound (`sounds`: saw, told or common), the `motive` the data grounds it in (an organisation they keep secrets for, a friend they cover for, a grudge, a profit, fear or pride), `why` in words (never shown), and the trust at which they stop (`until`). `rumours` start with someone who saw it (`path[0]`) and pass along `path`, drifting by a seeded rule (claims.ts `driftOf`): the number grows, and the place can move. `truth` is what was really seen; `core` is the words, with {n} and {where} filled in at each hop. With the `rumour-drift` switch (#1589): `{who}` is a name (truth `who`, a person on the road) that can swap for someone of the same People; `leak` names the organisation whose secret it is (it starts with a member and gets out through one who talks for a living); `feature` is the switch a rumour arrives with. `tellers` are how the road cultures the story engine has no `biasSeed` for (world/peoples.ts has the Reach's) tell a rumour, in the engine's own bias words (storytelling/types.ts `PerceptualBias`).

lies.text: The Compact? A story big folk tell about goblins, so there's someone to blame when a well turns. I've been a goblin all my life, and nobody has ever asked me to join anything.
lies.why: He's of the Compact, and the Compact keeps its business from outsiders. He'd rather deny it than say "not yet".
lies.source: src/artificer/villages.ts › The Compact pays better for news than for hides

lies.text: Salt's dear this spring, ask anyone on the mere: the crust came in thin after the ash winter, and the racks are half empty. Whatever the Gate pays for it, I can't go much under that.
lies.why: She sells salt, and a stranger who thinks it's scarce pays more for it. A friend gets the truth, and a friend's price.
lies.source: src/artificer/villages.ts › Salt fish, salt pork, salt everything

lies.text: Orrin at the ford? A woodwright with an anvil, the way he tells it, and that's all he is. I've never known him go near a hold.
lies.why: Orrin left his hold seat and won't say why. She's his friend, and keeps it for him until she knows who's asking.
lies.source: src/artificer/villages.ts › I left a hold seat for this forge. Nobody here has asked me why.
